element.reason: STUDIO-FRAMES: studio-specimen-v13 with its specimen frames left out until Studio has mounted and resolved its theme (a `deferred` input, true through the server render and hydration) and each frame keyed by its source as stock shadcn block-viewer keys its iframe, so no frame loads the server's light default, none is aborted by streaming or hydration, and a theme change mounts a fresh frame instead of keeping the stale document. Stock parts only: no hook, no react import, no raw markup.
